title: AI Browser Game Jam 5 starts NOW. The theme is TORCH!
author: Slackluster
selftext:
AI Browser Game Jam 5 is officially underway. Submissions are open now through October 30.

This round’s theme: TORCH

A torch in the dark. A torch song. Carrying a torch for someone. Passing the torch. Or just torching the whole thing down. Interpret it however you want or ignore it entirely, the theme is a suggestion, not a rule.

The rules are simple: make a free browser-playable game in two weeks using AI for whatever you want. Code, art, music, design, sound, anything.

A few details:

* No sponsor or required AI service
* Solo devs or teams
* Theme is optional
* Sharing your AI workflow/process is encouraged
* Participants play and rate the entries

The last jam had 126 entries and 248 people joined, so I’m really curious how big round 5 gets.

Jam page: [https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-5](https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-5)  
Discord: [https://discord.gg/86xBnZqHjy](https://discord.gg/86xBnZqHjy)

If you joined one of the previous jams, feel free to share what you made and what tools you used. Thanks for reading and have a nice day.
